name: polyphonic-transcriber-pro
description: Local Electron app for WAV to cleaned MIDI polyphonic transcription.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 dist-electron/electron/main.js && electron dist-electron/electron/main.js"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
